title: BUG: ruling 23c9277d071cd1f7 — P2's Stupefy finalizes first, then P1's Wind Wall targets and COUNTERS it (Wall stays 9, P2 draws 0); engine does not implement the play pass

history.note: needs missing engine capability: instructed plays must choose targets AT FINALIZATION (rule 355.5) — Wind Wall's effect is a bare {type:'counter'} with no target descriptor and Stupefy's lead target auto-binds, so no P2-then-P1 target Decision can surface. Prototyped the ordering half (look onPicked:banish + play-banished-pass wired up, chain sinking, cannotPlayCardsThisTurn) and the counter DID land correctly, but the required per-play target prompt is a new mechanism; reverted to avoid a half-fix in hot shared files
